material_observation_for_next_gate.title: The current-day incremental path has never executed in production
material_observation_for_next_gate.evidence: All six slices across JobRuns 76931, 76932 and 76933 ran as closed_date_reconciliation with incremental_floor_utc null. The floor computation, the floor-reached pagination stop, and the separation of observed-high advance from date-checkpoint advance have therefore never run against live data.
material_observation_for_next_gate.why_it_matters: This is exactly the code that the scheduler will execute on every poll once activated. Backlog completion says nothing about it.
material_observation_for_next_gate.consequence: The standard incremental validation is not a formality; it is the first live exercise of that path, and scheduler activation must not be considered until it has passed review.
material_observation_for_next_gate.interaction_to_watch: Because CNInfo batch-timestamps many announcements at 00:00 CST, the 30-minute overlap floor will frequently not be reached, so completeness will rest on pagination exhaustion rather than on the floor short-circuit. That is acceptable within the 2400-row daily capacity against an observed peak of 1533, but the validation evidence must report whether the floor was reached, the page count, and whether the observed high advanced while the date checkpoint correctly stayed at 2026-08-08.
